cs.t: Many affluent areas have already banned gas leaf blowers and it’s incredible how quiet the battery powered replacements are. I was in Palm Springs recently and had nearly walked past a landscaper using one before if occurred to me just how quiet it was - didn’t even interrupt our conversation. I believe it was a Stihl backpack version (maybe  https://www.stihlusa.com/products/blowers-and-shredder-vacs/... ) but yeah, highly recommend!
